run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-18T01:05:40Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is explained by the otel-demo/product-catalog Deployment: its pod template was changed to image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0 (deployment revision 2), which the registry rejects with 401 UNAUTHORIZED, leaving the only product-catalog pod in ImagePullBackOff/Pending with zero ready endpoints. Every failing path I traced terminates at product-catalog's ClusterIP 100.69.9.250:8080: frontend's grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct spans fail with gRPC 14 'connect EPERM 100.69.9.250:8080', checkout's PlaceOrder fails on the same dependency, recommendation's ListProducts fails, frontend returns HTTP 500 for /api/products/{id} and /api/checkout, and frontend-proxy emits 500s on its 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' spans and logs. frontend-proxy's own pod is Running/ready with 0 restarts, so the proxy is a symptom carrier, not the origin. Other otel-demo workloads (ad, cart, currency, payment, shipping, accounting, fraud-detection, load-generator, frontend and frontend-proxy themselves) showed no error spans and ready pods with 0 restarts. Who/what applied the invalid image cannot be seen because the change_history integration is not available; that is recorded as a gap.

claims.text: At 01:10:00Z frontend-proxy carried error spans on both of its HTTP operations: 'ingress' STATUS_CODE_ERROR 2.3 spans/s and 'router frontend egress' STATUS_CODE_ERROR 2.291 spans/s, alongside 9.7 and 9.709 spans/s STATUS_CODE_UNSET (an error share of roughly 19%).

frontend-proxy's error-span rate was background-level (~0.011-0.022 spans/s) up to the 01:06:00Z point, then rose to 5.85 spans/s at 01:08:00Z and 16.98 spans/s at 01:09:00Z (2m rate), and stayed elevated (10.6-18.0 spans/s) through 01:19:00Z.

frontend-proxy container logs at 01:15Z show its own 500 responses with upstream 'frontend': e.g. 'GET /api/products/66VCHSJNUP HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream', 'GET /api/products/LS4PSXUNUM ... 500 - via_upstream', 'GET /api/recommendations?productIds=2ZYFJ3GM2N ... 500' and 'POST /api/checkout ... 500 - via_upstream' (10618 lines matched the error/fail/500 filter in the 01:00-01:20Z window).

Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog now has deployment.kubernetes.io/revision=2 and its container image is quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0; every other otel-demo deployment still runs its normal image (ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-<component> or ghcr.io/open-feature/flagd:v0.12.8 / valkey/valkey:8.1.3-alpine) at revision 1 (flagd revision 2).

Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog reports replicas=1, unavailableReplicas=1, updatedReplicas=1 and condition Available=False with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable ('Deployment does not have minimum availability.') last updated 2026-11-18T01:06:08Z.

Pod product-catalog-56fbb5f966-h9xjk (owner ReplicaSet product-catalog-56fbb5f966, created 01:06:08Z) is Pending with Ready/ContainersReady=False (ContainersNotReady) and its product-catalog container is in state waiting reason ImagePullBackOff: 'Back-off pulling image "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0": ErrImagePull: failed to pull and unpack image ...: 401 UNAUTHORIZED'; restartCount is 0.

otel-demo events show the product-catalog rollout and pull failures: Pod product-catalog-56fbb5f966-8rw7j Scheduled/Pulling at 01:05:53Z and 'Failed to pull image ... 401 UNAUTHORIZED' at 01:05:56Z; Pod product-catalog-56fbb5f966-h9xjk Scheduled at 01:06:08Z with 5x Failed-to-pull-401, 21x 'Error: ImagePullBackOff' and 21x BackOff messages between 01:06:12Z and 01:11:23Z; ReplicaSet product-catalog-56fbb5f966 SuccessfulCreate 01:05:53Z and 01:06:08Z; Pod product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-qz548 'Stopping container product-catalog' at 01:06:00Z; Deployment product-catalog ScalingReplicaSet events at 01:05:53Z-01:06:08Z.

Service product-catalog exposes port 8080 with clusterIP 100.69.9.250, and the Endpoints object of the same name contains only notReadyAddresses 100.96.4.116 (targetRef Pod product-catalog-56fbb5f966-h9xjk) - i.e. no ready backend address for the service.

product-catalog stopped producing spans: oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct ran at 11.1-15.4 spans/s and oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts at 0.87-1.37 spans/s through the 01:07:00Z point, then both fell to 0 spans/s from the 01:09:00Z point onward (2m rate) and stayed 0 to 01:19:00Z.

frontend's gRPC client spans fail with the exact message '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect EPERM 100.69.9.250:8080 - Local (0.0.0.0:0)' on operation grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (rpc.grpc.status_code=14), and the same traces show frontend 'GET' and 'GET /api/products/{productId}' 500s plus frontend-proxy 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' 500s.

checkout spans show the same dependency failing: oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder errors with 'failed to prepare order: failed to get product #"6E92ZMYYFZ"' / '... #"LS4PSXUNUM"' and its child span oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (service checkout) errors with rpc.grpc.status_code=14 and 'connection error: desc = "transport: Error while dialing: dial tcp 100.69.9.250:8080: connect: operation not permitted"'.

Error spans at 01:15:00Z (10m rate) are concentrated on the product-catalog path: frontend 'GET' 5.198/s, frontend 'grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct' 4.295/s, frontend 'GET /api/products/{productId}' 4.263/s, frontend-proxy 'ingress' 5.767/s and 'router frontend egress' 5.760/s, recommendation '/oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts' 0.803/s and 'get_product_list' 0.803/s, checkout 'oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct' 0.508/s and 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' 0.508/s.

frontend's own error-span rate was 0 until the 01:07:00Z point, jumped to 4.8 spans/s at 01:07:00Z and ~11-12.8 spans/s afterwards, including 'grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct' 9.1-10.9 spans/s and 'GET /api/products/{productId}' 9.1-10.9 spans/s; the frontend-proxy error series show no samples at the 01:07:00Z/01:08:00Z points (unknown) and start at the 01:09:00Z point.

Only product-catalog is unhealthy at pod level: of 21 otel-demo pods, 20 are Running with every container ready and restartCount 0, including frontend-675fd7b5c5-gx54w, frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-zj87n, checkout-5dccddf8bb-z84lb and recommendation-5f45f75855-92wk6; the single exception is product-catalog-56fbb5f966-h9xjk (Pending, not ready).

Non-product-catalog dependencies show zero error spans at 01:15:00Z: ad 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean' 0, accounting 'orders receive' 0, payment 'GET', 'dns.lookup' and 'tcp.connect' 0, fraud-detection 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveInt' 0, frontend 'grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem' 0, 'grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart' 0, 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' 0, 'GET /api/cart' 0, 'POST /api/cart' 0 and 'GET /api/data' 0.

Rejected: the product-catalog pod is Pending because of scheduling or resource shortage. It reports PodScheduled=True and Initialized=True, and the only failure reason on the container and in the events is the registry 401 on image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0 (ErrImagePull / ImagePullBackOff), with no FailedScheduling or insufficient-resource event.

Rejected as the origin: a regression inside frontend or frontend-proxy. Both pods are ready with 0 restarts, and their error spans and logs all carry a downstream cause (frontend 500s from grpc ProductCatalogService/GetProduct status 14 to 100.69.9.250:8080; frontend-proxy 500s with upstream 'frontend'), while unrelated frontend routes (/api/cart, /api/data) show 0 error spans.

Hypothesis (not established): the 'connect EPERM' wording from frontend and checkout could in principle also be produced by a network-level drop between clients and product-catalog; the visible endpoint state (only notReadyAddresses for the ImagePullBackOff pod) explains it without a policy, but I could not verify policies because the NetworkPolicy read returned no objects (status no_data).

Restore a valid product-catalog image in Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog (the other components of this release run ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-<component>; confirm the last known-good product-catalog image/tag before applying), then confirm the new pod reaches Ready and that the Endpoints object for service product-catalog gets a ready address.

After the fix, re-check frontend-proxy error share (baseline before 01:06:00Z was ~0.011-0.022 error spans/s, i.e. essentially 0%) and the frontend /api/products 500 lines, to confirm the alert clears.

Identify who or what changed Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog to revision 2 with image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0 around 01:05:53Z-01:06:08Z using the Helm release / audit history, which is not available in this Run (change_history is not integrated).

gaps: Who or what edited Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog to image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0 is unknown: the change_history integration is not available, and no Kubernetes event names an actor for the spec change (only the resulting ReplicaSet/ScalingReplicaSet events at 01:05:53Z-01:06:08Z).

The NetworkPolicy read for namespace otel-demo returned no objects with view status no_data, so it neither confirms nor excludes a network-level cause for the 'connect EPERM' messages; I did not obtain an ok view of network policies.

kube-state-metrics series kube_deployment_status_replicas_available / kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready for deployment product-catalog and kube_pod_container_info for pod product-catalog-56fbb5f966-h9xjk returned no data (status no_data), so replica/availability time series for product-catalog are unknown; deployment and pod status were taken from the API objects at query time instead.

A query for metrics matching http_server_request_duration_seconds_count / http_.* returned no series (status no_data), so the alert's own metric expression and its reported value 18.18888888888889 were not verified; the ~19% error share cited here is derived from traces_span_metrics_calls_total on frontend-proxy.

Frontend application logs were unavailable: the fetch for pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-gx54w returned 0 lines (status no_data), so frontend-side log text for the 500s is unknown; the error detail came from its spans.

product-catalog application logs cannot exist for this incident because the container never started (ImagePullBackOff), and the logs of the terminated pod product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-qz548 are not readable after deletion.

Jaeger retains only the most recent traces and each traces_search view is a biased sample (some views reported incomplete: 'backend returned as many traces as requested'), so the call graph and the full set of failing callers of product-catalog are only partially observed.
Whether the 500s reached real users is unverified: the failing client shown is the synthetic load-generator (user_browse_product / user_checkout_multi spans), not customer traffic.
Whether errors existed before 01:05Z is unknown beyond the sampled window: events before 00:49:47Z were outside the returned event set and the 60s/120s metric views only start at 00:55Z-00:57Z.
next_steps: Confirm the last known-good product-catalog image from the Helm release history / previous Deployment revision and patch the Deployment back to it (not executed in this Run).
Consult cluster audit logs or the change_history integration to identify the actor and exact time of the product-catalog image change.

Once a product-catalog pod is Ready, verify the Endpoints object for service product-catalog has a ready address, then watch frontend-proxy 5xx rate and frontend /api/products 500s to confirm recovery.

If the 5xx persist after product-catalog is Ready, re-check network policies and firewall rules affecting TCP 8080 from frontend/checkout/recommendation to 100.69.9.250, since 'connect EPERM' was the observed socket error.
